title: Lebkuchen-Glazed Pineapple Skewers
description: A sweet and tangy twist on traditional German lebkuchen, these skewers combine caramelized pineapple with a hint of spicy ginger.
instructions: Cut the pineapple into 1-inch chunks and set aside.
Peel the ginger and slice into thin rounds.
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, water, and lemon juice. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the syrup has thickened slightly.
Add the ginger to the syrup and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Thread a pineapple chunk, a piece of ginger, and a piece of lebkuchen onto each skewer.
Brush the skewers with the syrup, making sure to coat all surfaces.
Melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Brush the melted butter over the skewers, then sprinkle with granulated sugar.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate for up to 2 hours before serving.
